body.name: V_dh
body.def: \(V_{d,h}(m_d)\) is the maximum of \(\sum_{z\in\mathcal N_h}v_{d,h,z}\nu_h(\{z\})\) subject to \(0\le v_{d,h,z}\le1\), \(|v_{d,h,z}-v_{d,h,z'}|\le M_d\|z-z'\|_2\) for all \(z,z'\in\mathcal N_h\), and \(\left|\sum_zv_{d,h,z}\mu_{dj,h}(\{z\})-m_{dj}\right|\le M_dh\) for every \(j\in J_d\).
